qa_pair.question: A finger-drum grid is dropped into a page with no layout set. How many pads sit side by side in one row by default? Answer with a number.
Take the lowest and the highest MIDI note a piano shows when it is left at its defaults, and subtract the lowest from the highest. What is the difference in semitones? Answer with a number.
On the vertical level meter with default settings, how many dB separate the bottom and the top of its scale? Answer with a number.
Which of the knob and the fader starts its range at 0 and moves in steps of 1 by default? Answer with the component name only.
When a tuner stops hearing a note, how many milliseconds does it keep showing that note by default? Answer with a number.
Subtract the lowest frequency a tuner listens for by default from the highest, in Hz. Answer with a number.
A spectrum analyzer's level axis runs from its default bottom value to its default top value, in dB. What is the span of that axis? Answer with a number.
On a knob, which key sets the value straight to its minimum? Answer with the key name as written in the docs.
Across the component pages, how many of them give a disabled prop a default of false in their API reference? Answer with a number.
Among the catalog entries in the pad category, which name comes first alphabetically? Answer with the full name.
